case_title: Prem Kumar Gulati v. State of Haryana
neutral_facts: The prosecution case was based on a dying declaration from the victim, who stated that her husband, along with her brother-in-law and his wife, poured kerosene oil on her and set her on fire. The victim also mentioned that her husband had an illicit relationship with his sister-in-law, leading to frequent quarrels and physical abuse. The investigation revealed that the accused brother-in-law and his wife were living separately and were found innocent during the investigation. The victim's daughter, who was eight years old, provided a statement that contradicted the dying declaration, suggesting that the victim's injuries were caused by a falling lamp. The trial court convicted all three accused individuals, but the Supreme Court found that there was no corroborative evidence to support the involvement of the brother-in-law and his wife in the offense. The Supreme Court acquitted the brother-in-law and his wife, while upholding the conviction of the husband.
